products.name: Document Processing
products.customerAction: Upload an image or multi-page PDF, process it and download the result.
products.customerBenefit: Handle document and image processing through one simple workflow.
products.verifiedScope: Image processing is verified by tests; multi-page PDF processing is deployed and verified through the production browser workflow.
limitations: The Windows evidence run skipped native PDF tests because Poppler was unavailable on that machine.

products.name: PDF Tools
products.customerBenefit: Build PDF documents directly from image pages.
products.verifiedScope: PDF creation and safety contracts are verified by tests; the active production runtime provides Poppler 24.02.0 and supports the deployed multi-page PDF workflow.
limitations: Native PDF tests were not executed in the recorded Windows test environment; production runtime evidence is recorded separately.

products.name: Image Processing
products.customerAction: Prepare and transform images for your workflow.
products.customerBenefit: Use different processing modes without building the processing pipeline yourself.
products.verifiedScope: Both image engines and the tested processing modes are verified with PNG fixtures.
limitations: Broader image-format compatibility and quality claims require additional verification.

products.name: Lossless Data Output
products.customerAction: Create compressed data outputs that can be restored to the original bytes.
products.customerBenefit: Reduce stored output while preserving the tested byte content exactly.
products.verifiedScope: Hybrid and Stigma fixture outputs restore the original input bytes exactly.
limitations: Lossless refers to the tested byte restoration contract, not to every image or document transformation.

products.name: Excel Integration
products.customerAction: Validate workbooks, preview their contents and retrieve reports through configured Excel services.
products.customerBenefit: Connect spreadsheet workflows to Lightning without manually rebuilding the integration.
products.verifiedScope: Protocol behavior is tested; current real upstream execution is not verified.
limitations: Real Excel upstream tests were skipped in the current evidence run.

products.name: License Management
products.customerAction: Create signed license keys and activate a workspace.
products.customerBenefit: Control access to commercial Lightning installations.
products.verifiedScope: Issuance, activation boundaries, signing-key rotation and audit contracts are verified.
limitations: Durable usage, expiry and complete entitlement enforcement still require work.
